dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: This restaurant has great seafood. I love seafood!
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈrɛstərɑːnt ˈhæz ˈɡreɪt ˈsiːfuːd. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈsiːfuːd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So do I! Let's order the seafood curry.
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊ duː ˈaɪ! ˈlɛts ˈɔːrdər ðə ˈsiːfuːd ˈkɜːri.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. But I can't eat very spicy food.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈiːt ˈvɛri ˈspaɪsi ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Neither can I. Let's get a mild one.
dialogue.reading: ˈniːðər kən ˈaɪ. ˈlɛts ˈɡɛt ə ˈmaɪld wʌn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. I don't eat much meat these days.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈiːt ˈmʌtʃ ˈmiːt ðiːz ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Neither do I. Is Ploy coming tonight? She's vegetarian, isn't she?
dialogue.reading: ˈniːðər duː ˈaɪ. ɪz ˈplɔɪ ˈkʌmɪŋ təˈnaɪt? ʃiːz ˌvɛdʒəˈtɛriən, ˈɪzənt ʃiː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She's vegan now. She doesn't eat meat, fish, eggs or milk.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈviːɡən ˈnaʊ. ʃiː ˈdʌzənt ˈiːt ˈmiːt, ˈfɪʃ, ˈɛɡz ɔːr ˈmɪlk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. There are some vegan dishes on the menu.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ðɛr ər sʌm ˈviːɡən ˈdɪʃɪz ɑːn ðə ˈmɛnjuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. Oh, and I can't eat peanuts. I'm allergic.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈoʊ, ənd aɪ ˈkænt ˈiːt ˈpiːnʌts. aɪm əˈlɜːrdʒɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll tell the waiter. No peanuts in your food!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈtɛl ðə ˈweɪtər. ˈnoʊ ˈpiːnʌts ɪn jʊr ˈfuːd!
